items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021

ctx.x: looking for somebody for the band.” You know and I was like, and I truthfully didn’t know a whole lot about the Thad Jones-Mel Lewis band. I knew Thad as a player. I knew his Five by Five, the Monk records that he did and also what he did early on with Mingus, “The Jazz Experiments of Charles Mingus” where you know, so I knew Thad’s playing. I didn’t really know his writing, but I guess I comped in the places that was good — so anyway I had a shot to do the big band and Mel Lewis gave me a heads up on what charts…
Not quite. That was a, we wore those records out in college, and still like what’s the Jerome Richardson tune?
